items.name: Energy
items.description: This ammunition has been enchanted with one of the following types of energy: acid, cold, fire, holy, lightning, thunder. An attack using this ammunition deals that type of damage.

items.name: Forceful Impact
items.description: When you hit with an attack using this ammunition, the target also pops free from each enemy engaged with it.

items.name: Keen
items.description: When you make an attack with this ammunition, the crit range of that attack expands by 1 (usually 18+ including the default bonus).

items.name: Lethal Strike
items.description: You deal +1d10 damage on a hit (champion: +2d10; epic: +4d10).

items.name: Lucky Stray
items.description: On a miss, you can make a basic ranged attack against another foe that is near the target or along your line of sight to the target (between you and the original target or past the original target).

items.name: Nemesis
items.description: This ammunition has been enchanted against one of the following groups of monsters: dragon, giant, orc, or undead. An attack against the designated nemesis with this ammunition can be rerolled once if it misses. When you use this ammunition, however, it allows each monster of the same group to reroll one attack against you that misses this battle. If you use this type of ammunition two or more times against the same creature group this battle, monsters of that type can instead reroll each attack against you that misses this battle (once per attack).

items.name: Seeking
items.description: You deal +4 damage on a miss (champion: +10; epic: +25).

items.name: Twin
items.description: When you attack with twin ammunition, a second projectile materializes out of the first and targets the same or a different enemy. Make a free action basic ranged attack for it with a +8 attack bonus instead of your normal bonus (champion: +12; epic: +16).

items.name: Vulnerability
items.description: When you hit with an attack using this ammunition, if the target is from the same tier or lower than the ammunition, it's also vulnerable to all attacks until the start of your next turn.

items.name: Wing-clipper
items.description: When you hit with an attack using this ammunition, if the target is from the same tier or lower than the ammunition, it loses the flight ability (save ends). If the target is presently flying, it must attempt to land during its next turn.

items.name: Flaming
items.description: Bursts into fire as it flies. You deal 8 extra ongoing fire damage on a hit (epic: 20 ongoing fire).

items.name: Death
items.description: When you hit with this ammunition and deal damage, if the target has 40 hp or fewer after the hit, the creature drops to 0 hp. If it hits but fails to drop its target, the ammunition is not used up. It must of course be retrieved.

items.name: Uncanny
items.description: It warps the forces of necessity and miracle as it flies. When you attack with this ammunition, use the target's lowest defense instead of the defense your attack would normally target.

items.name: Clever Step
items.description: (Usually light armor) You gain a +4 bonus to all defenses against opportunity attacks.
items.quirk: Likes to dance little jigs.

items.name: Heedlessness
items.description: You gain a +4 bonus to all defenses during your first turn in battle.
items.quirk: Needlessly provocative.

items.name: Iron Will
items.description: The default AC bonus applies to Mental Defense as well.
items.quirk: Prone to abstract speculation.

items.name: Last Stand
items.description: (Usually heavy armor) You gain a +4 bonus to AC while you have no recoveries left.
items.quirk: Has a high pain tolerance.

items.name: Perfection
items.description: (Usually heavy armor) You gain a +1 bonus to all defenses while at maximum hit points.
items.quirk: Made uneasy by the sight of blood.

items.name: Perseverance
items.description: (Quick action - daily) If you are staggered, you regain an expended power as if you had taken a quick rest. You automatically regain a once-per-battle power, but a recharge power requires a successful recharge roll. You can regain a racial power, class power, or magic item power this way.
items.quirk: Repeats stories over and over.

items.name: Splendor
items.description: Enemies engaged with you take a -2 attack penalty against allies without splendor.
items.quirk: Fastidious about clothing and gear.

items.name: Stone Flesh
items.description: The default AC bonus applies to Physical Defense as well.
items.quirk: Extremely stubborn.

items.name: Warding
items.description: You gain resistance 12+ against attacks targeting Physical Defense or Mental Defense.
items.quirk: Stretches and meditates whenever inactive.

items.name: Blademaster's Belt
items.description: One magical sword sheathed on this belt gains a +2 bonus to recharge rolls for its own powers.
items.quirk: Worries too much about tiny details.

items.name: Brutal Vigor
items.description: (Recharge 6+) When you rally, make a basic attack.
items.quirk: Plays with their weapons.

items.name: Glorious Rally
items.description: When you rally, you gain 4 temporary hit points that last until the end of your next turn (champion: 10 temp hp; epic: 25 temp hp).

items.name: Heroic Resolve
items.description: (Recharge 11+) You can use a recovery to prevent all damage from an attack (including ongoing damage), but not effects.
items.quirk: Has terrible heartburn.

items.name: Last Word
items.description: When you heal using your last remaining recovery, you heal 30 additional hit points (champion 75 hp; epic: 200 hp).
items.quirk: Stubbornly independent.

items.name: Potion Belt
items.description: (Recharge 16+) Drink a potion stored on this belt as a quick action instead of a standard action. (It also provides slots for up to six potions.)
items.quirk: Constantly attempts to refill everyone else's drinks. Or potions. Or ration bags.

items.name: Resilience
items.description: (Recharge 16+) When you rally, you can use a second recovery to heal after using the first (and seeing the recovery roll).
items.quirk: Grinningly optimistic.

items.name: Victory by Inches
items.description: You must carry a single magic melee weapon that you keep attached to this item for it to manifest its power. When using that weapon, apply the weapon's magic bonus to miss damage.
items.quirk: Have a hard time taking no for an answer.

items.name: Resurgence
items.description: (Recharge 16+) When you drop to 0 hit points or lower, heal using a recovery before falling unconscious.
items.quirk: Bursts forth with wildly optimistic comments from time to time.

items.name: Sash of Suppleness
items.description: (Recharge 6+) A silky sash worn as a belt. When an attack hits your AC and deals 16 damage or less, change that hit into a miss (epic: 40 damage or less).
items.quirk: Always stretching, even when it would be more polite or sensible to not be doing so.

items.name: Kilt of the Mad Archmage
items.description: (Recharge 11+) When you drop one or more foes with an arcane spell attack, heal using a recovery and gain a +4 bonus to attack rolls with spells until the end of your next turn.
items.quirk: Roll eyes and giggle too often for comfort.

items.name: Totem Kilt
items.description: A hide-and-fur skirt bedecked with garish tribal charms, totemic symbols, and spirit knots. You can reroll the first death save you make each battle. Add +2 to the roll.
items.quirk: Sometimes speaks with the voices of ancestors.

items.name: Vitality
items.description: Whenever you take ongoing damage, roll an immediate save to end the effect without taking damage first.
items.quirk: Fascinated by patterns.

items.name: Codex of Foreshadowed Victory
items.description: (Recharge 16+) When you roll initiative, gain a +10 bonus to your roll after seeing it.
items.quirk: Jumpy.

items.name: Manual of Enlightened Flesh
items.description: You gain a +1 bonus to all skill checks based on Str, Con, or Dex.
items.quirk: Takes heightened satisfaction in their own physical prowess.

items.name: Scroll of the Fortuitous Outlook
items.description: (Quick action - once per battle) Make a recharge roll for a recharge power you expended this turn (including a magic item power) If successful, you regain that power this turn.
items.quirk: Paranoid about the weather.

items.name: Scroll of Seven Subtle Serpents
items.description: (Recharge 6+) When you make a melee attack based on Dexterity, Intelligence, or Wisdom, evoke a special ability of your choice. Pick the ability from one of the following options after seeing whether the attack is a hit. Deal +1d6 damage on a hit (champion: +2d8; epic: +4d10). Deal +1d4 damage on a miss (champion: +2d6; epic: +4d8). Gain a +1 bonus to all defenses until the end of your next turn. Pop free from one enemy. Gain 1d10 temporary hit points (champion: 3d8; epic: 8d8). Roll a save against an ongoing save ends effect.
items.quirk: Always in constant motion, or swaying gently when still.

items.name: Scroll of the Unerring Shaft
items.description: (Recharge 11+) When you miss with a ranged weapon attack, turn that miss into a hit, dealing your ranged basic attack damage with the attack instead.
items.quirk: Sings snatches of nonsense.

items.name: Tome of the Divinities and their Deeds
items.description: (Recharge 16+) When you cast a divine spell, heal using a recovery and add +1d6 hit points to the total (champion: +2d8 hp; epic: +4d10 hp).
items.quirk: Sees the hands of the gods operating subtly through the natural and social world, and makes others aware of it.

items.name: Tome of the Open Mind
items.description: (Recharge 16+) When you roll a skill check using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma and dislike the result, reroll the check.
items.quirk: Annoyingly curious.

items.name: Manual of Puissant Skill at Arms
items.description: (Recharge 11+) When you miss with a melee attack, reroll the attack using +15 as your attack bonus instead of your own bonus (epic: +20). If an arcane spellcaster reads this manual, it hurts their brain and permanently reduces their maximum hit points by 4 (epic: by 10).
items.quirk: Constantly checking self out and flexing, and seems to want to be caught doing that.

items.name: Tome of Arcane Mysteries
items.description: (Recharge 11+) When you make an attack roll with an arcane spell, after finding out whether the attack hits, change the attack roll to a 10 instead of the natural roll.
items.quirk: Doodles insane geometrical designs.

items.name: Boots of Elvenkind
items.description: You gain a +4 bonus to skill checks to walk quietly.
items.quirk: Develops a love of elegant elven poetry.

items.name: Boots of Rhythm
items.description: You have a +4 bonus to dance checks.
items.quirk: Loves to learn new dances.

items.name: Boots of Sure Feet
items.description: You can walk or run normally through terrain that would usually slow one down, such as rubble, undergrowth, muck, etc. The boots don't protect you against damage or similar effects incurred from inhospitable terrain.
items.quirk: Becomes exceptionally picky about diet.

items.name: Boots of Ferocious Charge
items.description: Whenever you move to engage a foe first and then make a melee attack against it during the same turn, you deal +1d6 damage, hit or miss (champion: +2d8; epic: +4d10).
items.quirk: You like to start fights as much as you like to finish them.

items.name: Sandals of the Slippery Eel
items.description: (Recharge 11+) Reroll a failed disengage check.
items.quirk: Loves puns.

items.name: Slayer's Boots
items.description: (Recharge 11+) When one or more creatures attempt to intercept you while you're moving to engage an enemy during your turn, you dodge past them instead so they can't intercept.
items.quirk: Recites death poems of ancient heroes. At length.

items.name: Wise Eyelet Boots
items.description: (Quick action - recharge 16+) If you were the last creature to take its turn this round, you pop free from all enemies.
items.quirk: Hesitates before speaking.

items.name: Sandals of Wall Striding
items.description: (Recharge 6+) Until the end of your next turn, you can move normally along a wall or vertical surface as if you were flying.
items.quirk: Has compulsion to snatch small insects out of the air and pop them into mouth when they think no one is watching.

items.name: Adroit Avoidance
items.description: (Recharge 6+) When an attack or effect deals ongoing damage to you that a save ends, you can roll an immediate save against it.
items.quirk: Doesn't notice social slights or insults.

items.name: Elven
items.description: Add +4 to checks to hide in natural surroundings.
items.quirk: Prefers the finest things in life; of course, they are elven.

items.name: Evasion
items.description: (Recharge 6+) When you take damage from an opportunity attack, take 20 less damage from it (champion: 40; epic: 100)
items.quirk: You can't answer a question directly even if you want to.

items.name: Recovery
items.description: (Quick action - recharge 16+) You heal using a recovery and add +4 hp to the total (champion: +10 hp; epic: +25 hp).
items.quirk: You grow small extra appendages that slowly wither away over days or weeks.

items.name: Shelter
items.description: This long cloak with a full hood keeps you warm and dry, regardless of the elements, barring full immersion in water or other liquid.
items.quirk: Prefers the outdoors.

items.name: Stalwart
items.description: (Recharge 16+) When an attack against your Physical Defense hits, make the attacker reroll the attack and use a PD of 15 instead (champion: 20; epic: 25).
items.quirk: Always the last to retreat or avoid danger.

items.name: Guardian
items.description: (Recharge 11+) When a foe you're engaged with targets your ally with an attack that doesn't include you, make that enemy target you instead of that ally. Declare your choice before the attack is rolled. (Epic: recharge 6+.)
items.quirk: Compelled to the defense of others, even those who might not need defending.

items.name: Inviolability
items.description: (Recharge 16+) When an attack against your Physical Defense hits, change that hit into a miss instead.
items.quirk: Attempts stunts of toughness and daring that a person less convinced of their invulnerability might be wise enough to avoid.

items.name: Ambidexterity
items.description: (Recharge 11+) When you roll a natural 16+ with your first melee attack during your turn while wielding a weapon in your off-hand, make a melee attack with the weapon in your off-hand as a free action, using +10 as your attack bonus (champion: +15; epic: +20).
items.quirk: Writes with both hands at the same time on different parts of the page. It freaks people out.

items.name: Arcane Contact
items.description: These gloves improve your ability to contact, detect, and distinguish supernatural forces, provided you can touch some material object connected to a force. If, for example, you are improvising a ritual to gain a vision related to the scary artifact you just found, touching the artifact will help. The benefit is modest, determined by the GM, and possibly secret. The gloves provide no protection against the supernatural forces that touching an artifact might usher into your soul.
items.quirk: Always cracks knuckles.

items.name: Archer's Gauntlets
items.description: (Recharge 16+) When you miss with a ranged weapon attack, reroll it using +10 as your attack bonus (champion: +15; epic: +20).
items.quirk: You're quiet. Too quiet. Say something.

items.name: Gauntlets of Clobbering
items.description: (Recharge 16+) You deal +1d8 damage with two-handed weapons until the end of the battle (champion: +2d8; epic: +4d10).
items.quirk: Clobber first, talk later.

items.name: Gloves of Mind Rot
items.description: (Recharge 6+) When you hit one or more foes with an arcane spell attack, deal +1d10 psychic damage to one target of the attack (champion: +2d10; epic: +5d10).
items.quirk: The texture of your skin seems wrong to everyone else, but you know it's all in their minds and often explain that to them.

items.name: Jeweled Glove
items.description: (Recharge 6+) When you cast a divine spell, allow one nearby ally to roll a save against one ongoing save ends effect as a free action.
items.quirk: Alternately paranoid that people are looking too closely at your precious jeweled glove and upset that people aren't paying enough attention to your amazing jeweled glove.

items.name: Musical Touch
items.description: While you wear these fine silk gloves, you can play any musical instrument without instruction. The gloves, however, don't make you any more of a musician than you already are.
items.quirk: Hums and picks up tunes easily.

items.name: Sure Fingers
items.description: You gain a +2 bonus to any skill check that involves sleight of hand, strength of grip, hand-eye coordination, or similar abilities.
items.quirk: Holds a pinky finger up when holding a cup.

items.name: Circlet of Approachability
items.description: While wearing this circlet, in regular social situations, you appear to others as someone who belongs there. You easily fit in with new groups of people, unless there is some particular reason for others to be suspicious. The circlet has no power in unusual social situations.
items.quirk: Peppers speech with needless foreign words.

items.name: Helm of Fortunate Dodging
items.description: (Recharge 11+, and see below) When an enemy misses you with an attack against your AC or PD, change that miss into a fumble (no damage or possibly a negative outcome).
items.quirk: Easily moved to dancing by rhythmic music, and taps foot when there is no music.

items.name: Helm of Psychic Armor
items.description: (Recharge 16+) When an attack that targets Mental Defense hits you, cancel the attack's non-damage effects against you.
items.quirk: Won't stop going on about "the amazing dream I had last night."

items.name: Helm of Psychic Retribution
items.description: (Recharge 16+) When an enemy misses you with an attack that targets Mental Defense, deal 10 psychic damage to that enemy (champion: 25 damage; epic: 60 damage).
items.quirk: Stares into space often.

items.name: Helm of the Undaunted Hero
items.description: (Recharge 6+): When your turn starts, roll a save against one ongoing save ends effect.
items.quirk: Favors traditional battle hymns.

items.name: Skullcap of Wit
items.description: You can banter with a lively wit. If you already have a lively wit, it doesn't make much of a difference. Interpret this ability narrowly enough that it might provide a bonus to a die roll that anyone really cares about only once in a campaign.
items.quirk: Banters with lively wit.

items.name: Crown of the Mighty Strike
items.description: (Recharge 16+) This slim but elegant crown wants to share your glory and thus needs you to be glorious. It continually presses you to take bold actions. If the escalation die is 3+, use your next daily attack power this battle as a quick action.
items.quirk: Likely to make bold statements or undertake bold actions, especially by reflex.

items.name: Bearclaw
items.description: (Recharge 11+) When you hit with a melee attack while you're staggered, gain 10 temporary hit points (champion: 25 temporary hp; epic: 50 temporary hp).
items.quirk: Swaggers even when overmatched.

items.name: Cups
items.description: When you're drunk, you don't accidentally say or do stupid things that you regret in the morning, and your head doesn't hurt so bad.
items.quirk: Not reluctant to drink excessively in public.

items.name: Last Legs
items.description: You gain a +1 bonus to saves whenever you have one or fewer recoveries left (champion: two or fewer, epic: three or fewer).
items.quirk: Loves long-shot bets.

items.name: Lifestone
items.description: The stones in the necklace breathe, ever so slightly. You gain a +5 bonus to death saves, if failure would kill you. You also gain a +5 bonus to last gasp saves.
items.quirk: Chides others for taking risks when they have lesser magical protection.

items.name: Momentous Harmony
items.description: The pendant brings out the best in other magic items you carry, so that their quirks turn more positive, or at least become weaker if they cause trouble. If you go over your magic item limit, the pendant ceases to function (including the default bonus) and the formerly subdued magic items express themselves with renewed fervor.
items.quirk: Treats all their magic items well-talks to them as if they're alive, refers to them as "children," etc.

items.name: Paragon
items.description: (Recharge 16+) This necklace changes shape and jewels depending on the race of the wearer. When you use this necklace, you gain another use of your racial power in the battle.
items.quirk: Sometimes unwittingly speaks in a language that sounds like it could be the original language of their race, if anyone else could understand it.

items.name: Water Breathing
items.description: (Recharge 6+) This band of aquamarine and pearls enables you to breathe water for a short time, usually about five minutes. The effect wears off slowly, so you'll have warning to get to the surface.
items.quirk: Hiccups in stressful situations.

items.name: Cheap Shot
items.description: (Quick action - recharge 11+) One enemy you're engaged with takes damage equal to your normal melee miss damage.
items.quirk: Often stops speaking mid-sentence.

items.name: Defense
items.description: (Recharge 6+) When you take damage from an attack, prevent 10 of that damage (champion: prevent 20; epic: prevent 40).
items.quirk: Stubborn.

items.name: Glory
items.description: This brilliant, gem-encrusted ring gives you an aura of status (and whatever that entails). Everyone can see it, even if they don't know why.
items.quirk: Becomes more and more obsessed with the idea that all their accomplishments are undeserved and that they themselves are frauds. This obsession often drives them to heroic acts.

items.name: Instant Vengeance
items.description: (Recharge 16+) When you take damage from an enemy's attack, choose one ally you can see. That ally can make a basic attack (melee or ranged) against the attacker as a free action.
items.quirk: Sticks close to their friends, real close.

items.name: Iron Grip
items.description: When you make a skill check involving climbing, holding something, or otherwise using your hands to grip things, you can use +10 as your bonus in place of your normal bonus (level + ability mod + background; other magic item bonuses still count) (champion: +15; epic: +20).
items.quirk: Loves to arm wrestle, thumb wrestle, drum fingers on tables, etc.

items.name: Jack of All Trades
items.description: When you make a skill check, if your background bonus for that check is +1 or +0, you gain a +2 bonus for your background bonus instead (if your bonus is +2 or higher, this ring has no effect).
items.quirk: Talks as though they know everything.

items.name: Relentless Strike
items.description: (Standard action - recharge 16+) Make a basic attack ignoring any effects that give you an attack penalty, prevent you from attacking, keep you from taking actions, or force you to reroll the attack. You can also use this ring's power while you're stunned, even though you couldn't normally take an action.
items.quirk: Has near-constant insomnia.

items.name: Resilience
items.description: (Recharge 6+) When you use this ring, heal using a recovery.
items.quirk: Eats an odd vegetarian diet and advocates it loudly.

items.name: Skin of Your Teeth
items.description: (Recharge 6+) When an enemy attacks you, subtract 1 from the natural attack roll after seeing it.
items.quirk: Regularly finds copper pieces and other minor valuables on the ground.

items.name: Thief's-Eye
items.description: While the ring is on your finger, if you shut both eyes and concentrate, you can see through the ring, allowing you to peer around corners and such.
items.quirk: You're always prying into things that should maybe be left shut; doors, topics of conversation, taboos....

items.name: Wild Heart
items.description: Animals accept you and may even show you affection. The animals, however, still react normally if you threaten them, and well-trained guard animals are especially wary of you.
items.quirk: Seems out of place in civilization.

items.name: Adaptation
items.description: Whenever an enemy's attack hits your Physical Defense or Mental Defense, you gain a +4 bonus to that defense until an attack against that defense (including the bonus) misses you, or until the end of the battle.
items.quirk: Takes on mannerisms of those around them.

items.name: Bashing
items.description: When you move to engage an enemy while using this shield, you can use the shield to push that enemy away from one of your allies engaged with it. That ally can make a disengage check as a free action.
items.quirk: Can't pass up an opportunity to sing.

items.name: Drakefanged
items.description: (Recharge 11+) This spiked shield sports a massive dragon fang that wounds enemies. When an enemy engaged with you misses you with a melee attack, make a basic melee attack against the enemy as a free action, with a +2 attack bonus per tier of the shield (adventurer: +2, champion: +4, epic: +6). On a hit, the attack deals 2d6 damage; on a miss, it deals 2 damage (champion: 4d8 damage, or 5 on a miss; epic: 8d10 damage, or 12 on miss).
items.quirk: Compares everything to dragons or to draconic things, and judges actions by how they stack up to draconic expectations.

items.name: Protection
items.description: Enemies engaged with you take a -1 attack penalty against your allies.
items.quirk: Tends to others with too much familiarity.

items.name: Puissance
items.description: (Recharge 6+) When you make a basic melee attack, make a recharge roll for one expended power.
items.quirk: Tremendous appetite for meat.

items.name: Resilience
items.description: (Recharge 11+) When you make a basic melee attack, heal using a recovery.
items.quirk: Eats an odd vegetarian diet and advocates it loudly.

items.name: Spiked
items.description: When you roll a natural 2 with a melee attack while using the shield, you can make a basic melee attack with the shield as a free action as if it were an off-hand weapon (use d6 damage dice).
items.quirk: Has shifty eyes.

items.name: Termination
items.description: (Recharge 6+) When you make a basic melee attack, roll a save against one ongoing damage effect.
items.quirk: Continually fails to finish sentences, stopping in mid-thoug....

items.name: Diabolical Staff
items.description: (Recharge: 16+, but see below) You can evoke the power of the staff to gain additional attention and power from the spirits of darkness. When you roll relationship dice with a villainous icon, treat a single 4 as a 5. If you don't roll a 4, the staff recharges automatically during your next quick rest.
items.quirk: Exaggerates a chaotic or destructive trait that is already there.

items.name: Staff of Health
items.description: When you cast spells that heal or provide temporary hit points, add 4 to the total (epic: 8).
items.quirk: The diseased of nearly every population center somehow know to seek you out for healing.

items.name: Staff of the Diffident Magician
items.description: (Recharge 6+) The first time an enemy engages you, make an opportunity attack against that enemy. On a hit, you deal +2d8 damage with that attack (epic: +4d10) and daze the foe until the end of its turn, if the creature is large or smaller (epic: any size).
items.quirk: Doesn't like to be touched.

items.name: Staff of the God's Riches
items.description: (Recharge 16+) When you cast a cleric spell using this staff, you can cast the spell both for power and for broad effect (if applicable), choosing different targets.
items.quirk: Careless with money.

items.name: Staff of Manipulation
items.description: When you cast an attack spell using this staff, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage with that spell if it has any additional negative effect on the target(s) besides damage (including ongoing damage).
items.quirk: Expects to be treated with respect.

items.name: Staff of Massacres
items.description: When you cast an attack spell using this staff, you gain a +1 attack bonus with that spell if it has more than one target.
items.quirk: Obsessed with numbers and calculations.

items.name: Staff of the Uncrowned King
items.description: (Recharge 6+) When you use this power, you automatically succeed on a save against an effect created or caused by an undead enemy.
items.quirk: You see dead people...sometimes.

items.name: Staff of the Imperium
items.description: (Standard action - recharge 16+) The power of this golden staff can only be invoked by a spellcaster who has a positive or conflicted relationship with any ruling icon. When you use this power, you can use the power of any other magic item you have touched since your last full heal-up, but you can only use each such individual item power once ever.
items.quirk: Becomes certain that they are destined to rule.

items.name: Chosen One, Sign of the
items.description: When you cast your last divine daily spell, roll a save. If you succeed, you don't expend the spell.
items.quirk: Obsessed with fortune telling, oracles, signs, etc.

items.name: Divine Harmony, Knot of
items.description: (Standard action - recharge 16+) When you use this knot, you can serve in a priestly function for nearly any god or ritual. You can use this power to meet a free-form challenge, at the GM's discretion.
items.quirk: Believes in everything.

items.name: Dodging Doom, Symbol of
items.description: (Recharge 6+) When you cast a divine spell on an ally, that ally can roll a save against one ongoing save ends effect as a free action.
items.quirk: Wildly optimistic.

items.name: Dominating Truth, Symbol of
items.description: (Recharge 11+) When you cast a divine spell that affects one target with a limited amount of hit points (for example, turn undead), you can instead have that spell affect two targets with half the hit point requirement or less.
items.quirk: Never admits they're wrong.

items.name: Gathered Power, Symbol of
items.description: (Recharge with full heal-up) When you use this symbol during a quick rest, you regain an expended daily adventurer-level spell (1st or 3rd level, in practice) (champion: champion-level spell, 5th or 7th).
items.quirk: Has one-track mind.

items.name: Godlike Glory, Holy Symbol of
items.description: When you cast a daily spell, you gain 2d4 temporary hit points (champion: 4d6 temp hp, epic: 7d10 temp hp).
items.quirk: Dispenses pithy observations.

items.name: The Gods and Goddesses, Gem of
items.description: (Recharge 6+) When you cast a daily divine spell on an ally, that ally also heals 10 hit points.
items.quirk: Insists on courtesy even in situations where none should be required.

items.name: Greater Power, Relic of
items.description: (Recharge 11+) When you cast a quick action divine spell that targets allies, the spell affects one additional ally.
items.quirk: Keeps the relic meticulously clean, rests it on velvet, etc.

items.name: Body Breaking, Dagger of
items.description: This rune-covered bronze dagger also works as a wand. When you cast an arcane attack spell using this dagger/wand, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage with that spell if it targets PD.
items.quirk: Scratches self unnervingly.

items.name: Flaring Wand
items.description: (Quick action - recharge 11+) When the escalation die is 5+, cast one of your arcane spells. That spell will miss on any natural odd roll.
items.quirk: Often looks frazzled.

items.name: Infighting, Wand of
items.description: When you cast an arcane attack spell using this wand, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage with that spell if it's a close-quarters spell.
items.quirk: Physically pushy.

items.name: Mage's Invisible Aegis, Wand of the
items.description: (Recharge 16+) When you use this wand, you can cast the wizard's shield spell, with a level no higher than your level. (Champion: recharge 11+).
items.quirk: Hums tunelessly.

items.name: Mindbending, Wand of
items.description: When you cast an arcane attack spell using this wand, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage with that spell if it targets Mental Defense.
items.quirk: Uses pedantically circumlocutious phraseology.

items.name: Unfettered Minion, Wand of
items.description: (Quick action - recharge: 11+) When you use this wand, a creature who is at least somewhat subservient to you gains a +1 bonus to melee attacks and damage until the end of the battle (champion: +2 bonus).
items.quirk: Switches unexpectedly into "evil mastermind" tone of voice.

items.name: Wand of Unerring Pain
items.description: (See below - recharge 16+): When you miss with a spell that targets a single enemy, as a quick action immediately afterward, fire a magical missile that automatically hits that creature for 4d10 force damage.
items.quirk: Stares intently, often at nothing.

items.name: Abandon
items.description: (Melee weapon) You deal +2d6 damage with your first attack each battle using this weapon (champion: +4d6; epic: +4d12).
items.quirk: Blurts out obscenities. (For decorum's sake, use euphemisms when speaking in character.)

items.name: Bloodthirsty
items.description: (Any weapon) When you crit with a natural 20 using this weapon, you deal crit damage instead of normal damage if you hit with this weapon again during your next turn.
items.quirk: Has taste for red meat.

items.name: Certain Pain
items.description: (Two-handed melee weapon - recharge 11+) Before making an attack with this weapon, designate it as a "pain" attack. On a hit with that attack, one target takes 10 extra damage. On a miss, you take 10 damage (champion: 25 damage; epic: 60 damage).
items.quirk: Fond of gambling.

items.name: Climactic Shot
items.description: (Ranged weapon - recharge 6+) When the escalation die is 3+ and you hit with an attack using this weapon, the target takes 10 extra damage (champion: 25 damage; epic: 60 damage).
items.quirk: Can't stop checking the weapon and its ammunition.

items.name: Cruel
items.description: (Any weapon - recharge 11+) When damage from this weapon leaves an enemy with 20 hit points or fewer, you deal 5 ongoing damage to it (champion: 40 hp/10 ongoing damage; epic: 80 hp/20 ongoing damage).
items.quirk: Tortures flies.

items.name: Dexterous Parry
items.description: (One-handed melee weapon - recharge 11+) When an enemy you are engaged with hits you while you're wielding this weapon, make a Dexterity check against the attacker's MD. If you succeed, the attack misses instead.
items.quirk: Jumpy and suspicious.

items.name: Distraction
items.description: (Two-handed melee weapon - recharge 11+) When you hit with this weapon, allow one of your allies engaged with that foe to make a basic melee attack against it as a free action.
items.quirk: Intrudes on personal space.

items.name: Flurry
items.description: (Two-handed melee weapon - recharge 11+) When you make a basic attack, make a second basic attack against a different enemy as a free action.
items.quirk: Fidgety.

items.name: Guardian
items.description: (One-handed melee weapon) When you hit with an opportunity attack using this weapon, the target is weakened until the end of that turn (-4 attacks and defenses).
items.quirk: Looks serious all the time.

items.name: Greater Striking
items.description: (Melee weapon) While the escalation die is 3+, you deal +1d8 damage whenever you hit with this weapon (champion: +2d8; epic: +4d8).
items.quirk: Favors iron and steel, seeing little beauty in gold or gems.

items.name: Haughty
items.description: (Any weapon) When you hit with an attack using this weapon, if that enemy is the most dangerous foe in the battle (or tied for most dangerous, GM's assessment), you deal +1d4 per tier damage to it (champion: +1d8 per tier; epic: +1d10 per tier).
items.quirk: Challenges others to improvised contests.

items.name: Inimical
items.description: (Any weapon) When you hit with this weapon, you can deal +1d10 damage to that enemy (champion: +2d10; epic: +4d10). If you do, you also take that extra damage.
items.quirk: Bites nails, or a similar darker habit.

items.name: Liberation
items.description: (Melee weapon - quick action - recharge 6+) If you have attacked with this weapon this turn, allow an ally to roll a save against an ongoing save ends effect as a free action.
items.quirk: Drones on about how healing grace will save all the worlds.

items.name: Mauling
items.description: (Two-handed melee weapon - move action) You gain a +1 attack bonus to your next attack you make this turn.
items.quirk: Yells battle cries during battle.

items.name: Mighty Swing
items.description: (Two-handed melee weapon - move action) You deal +1d8 damage with your next melee attack with this weapon that hits this turn (champion: +2d8; epic: +4d8). If you miss, you take that damage instead.
items.quirk: Tends to break things.

items.name: No Mercy
items.description: (Ranged weapon) If your target is attempting to flee from the battle, a natural even hit against it is a critical hit instead.
items.quirk: Develops a surprising lip-curl sneer that shows up a bit too often.

items.name: Protection
items.description: (Melee weapon - recharge 6+) When you make a basic attack with this weapon, gain a +4 bonus to all defenses until the end of your next turn (champion: +5; epic: +6).
items.quirk: Has urges to watch over the helpless or innocent.

items.name: Puissance
items.description: (Melee weapon - recharge 16+) When you make a basic attack with this weapon, make a recharge roll for one power.
items.quirk: Tremendous appetite for meat.

items.name: Steady
items.description: (Ranged weapon - recharge 11+) Before rolling a ranged attack with this weapon, choose 10 as the natural roll for that attack.
items.quirk: Talks too much about the weather.

items.name: Unstinting Virtue
items.description: (Melee weapon - recharge 11+) When you make a basic attack with this weapon, roll a save against a save ends effect.
items.quirk: Insists that all weakness is an illusion.

items.name: Vanity
items.description: (Melee weapon) When you hit with this weapon, deal +1d6 damage to that enemy if you are the only one engaged with it (champion: +2d6; epic: +4d6).
items.quirk: Tells their name (their real one) to everyone.

items.name: Vengeance
items.description: (Melee weapon) When you hit with this weapon while you are staggered, deal +1d6 damage to that enemy.
items.quirk: Quick to take offense.

items.name: Longbow of Fallen Grace
items.description: (+3 longbow - recharge 16+) If your elven grace racial ability roll failed this turn, use the natural result of this bow's attack roll as another elven grace roll, after you see the roll.
items.quirk: Complains too often that the glorious centuries of old are gone forever.

items.name: Mighty Stunning
items.description: (One-handed blunt 1d6 melee weapon - recharge 16+) When you roll a natural even hit with this weapon and have more hit points than the target, that creature is also stunned until the end of its next turn.
items.quirk: Warns of impending doom.

items.name: Reckless
items.description: (Melee weapon - recharge 6+) Reroll one of your attack rolls with a +4 bonus. In addition, until the end of the battle, enemies attacking you add the escalation die to their attack roll (no effect if the enemy already adds it for some reason).
items.quirk: Low impulse control, particularly when it comes to impulsive movements through doors, onto railings, or over tables.

items.name: Greatsword of Utter Night
items.description: (+3 greatsword - recharge 6+) When you hit with this weapon, you spirit away that enemy and yourself to an empty void beyond time where only the two of you face each other for a short time. Neither you nor your foe can move, but you can sure fight. Your enemy acts first, then you, and then you are both spirited back to the real world exactly where you were when the power triggered. Bystanders only see a flash of black.
items.quirk: Has disturbing dreams that can't be remembered, or at the very least must not be.

items.name: Incomparable Axe of Wyrm Chopping
items.description: (+3 axe) Whenever you attack a dragon with the axe, you deal +40 damage, hit or miss. The GM determines just how broadly the term "dragon" applies.
items.quirk: Speaks in Draconic, first just curses, but then more and more elements of speech.

items.name: Lore Bottle
items.description: A bottle of translucent glass, sealed with lead, with a ghastly face that peers out at you. When you ask it questions, it answers in the form of vague hunches. For tough questions, the face might fade out for a while, apparently searching somewhere for an answer. Owning the bottle gives you +2 bonus to Intelligence-based skill checks, if you have the time (and privacy) to consult the lore bottle. Chances are, your particular lore bottle has some sort of specialty or bias, which you will discover only through use. Unlike most magic items, lore bottles can often be found for sale, but you probably don't want those.
items.quirk: The connection formed with the face in the bottle can be compelling and unsettling, as the spirit literally "gets in your head." Each bottle has a different effect on its owner.

items.name: Dwarven Mug
items.description: One in four mugs of ale you drink from this mug will be magically transformed into the very finest non-magical dwarven ale. If your relationship with the mug is good, the variety might even suit your current mood and the odds of getting a good brew might improve in your favor. But really, who's going to complain about putting down a second, or even third, mug for the chance to get a taste of the best stuff? When that excellent ale does show up, you can share a sip or two with a friend, but other attempts to capitalize on this mug's magic will just shut it down until it can find a more suitable owner.
items.quirk: Speaks in dwarven, especially while drunk, even if ordinarily unable to speak dwarven.

items.name: Rope of Entangling
items.description: Fifty feet of fine, spidersilk rope, woven so closely that it seems like a solid, flexible cable. Once you attune the rope during a full heal-up, you can make it entangle things with standard action commands. In combat, it's not that useful, because it's slow compared to a living thing. If the target is stationary, however, the rope excels at reaching, climbing, snaking, coiling, and entangling. You might be able to get the rope to bind a ferocious monster, but the rope is likely to get destroyed in the process.
items.quirk: Speaks in sentences for which "convoluted" is the only proper term.

items.name: Chitin Claw
items.description: (ring) This fleshy multi-eyed loop sheaths a finger in sharp carapace. Always: When you pick a lock, disarm a trap, or otherwise perform a task that having a tiny shape-changing blade and tiny eyes attached to your finger would be aided by, you gain a +2 bonus to the roll.
items.quirk: Gnarled over-long fingers on that hand.

items.name: Chuul Helm
items.description: (helm) This insectile segmented helm is lined with ganglia that link with your brain. Always: +1 MD (adventurer); +2 MD (champion); +MD (epic). Chuulish recharge: You gain resist psychic 12+ until the end of the battle (champion: resist psychic 16+; epic: resist psychic 18+).
items.quirk: Bone-ridged holes in skull.

items.name: Chuulish Cuirass
items.description: (heavy armor) The many eyes and symbiotic nervous system in this torso armor give you warning of danger. Always: +1 AC (adventurer); +2 AC (champion); +3 AC (epic). Chuulish recharge: You gain a +4 bonus to all defenses against ranged attacks until the end of the battle.
items.quirk: Over-large protruding ribs.

items.name: Clawed Tentacles
items.description: (gloves) These claw-covered tentacles normally reside under the skin of the forearm, completely concealed. Chuulish recharge: Choose an enemy engaged with you. Until the end of the battle, whenever that enemy tries to disengage from you or pop free from you, it must first succeed at an easy save (champion: normal save; epic: hard save).
items.quirk: Tentacles writhe in and out of the skin unexpectedly.

items.name: Death Claw
items.description: (gloves) A lobster-clawed gauntlet that fits over your forearm. The eyes at the fleshy joints blink unnervingly. Chuulish recharge: Reroll a missed melee attack with a +1 attack bonus (champion: +2; epic: +3).
items.quirk: The claw flexes and snaps reflexively when wearer is excited.

items.name: Evil Eyes
items.description: (gloves) This gauntlet has eyes on the knuckles, aiding archers and spellcasters. Always: Bonus to attacks and damage with ranged attacks: +1 (adventurer); +2 (champion); +3 (epic). The bonus doesn't stack with bonuses from magic weapons or implements. Chuulish recharge: Until the end of the battle or for five minutes, you can see the unseen. Invisible creatures are visible to you, and you spot illusions for what they are.
items.quirk: Bone ridges and oddly patterned callouses on the arms.

items.name: Glandular Parasite
items.description: (cloak/mantle The parasite sits along your spine, feeding off your life force but also dampening your reactions to extreme stimuli and pain. Always: +1 PD (adventurer); +2 PD (champion); +3 PD (epic). Chuulish recharge: You are immune to fear effects until the end of the battle or for five minutes.
items.quirk: Strangely pronounced spine.

items.name: Implanted Aventail
items.description: (light armor) The symbiote is normally hidden. When commanded, a wave of small crab-like creatures pours out of concealed gill-like openings in your skin, providing you with scale-like armor. Always: +1 AC (adventurer); +2 AC (champion); +3 AC (epic). Unleashing the armor is a quick action, and you retain the AC bonuses as long as it is in place. When the insects are retracted as a move action, you don't appear to be (or count as) wearing armor.
items.quirk: Gill-like slits cover body even when the armor is not up.

items.name: Neural Blade
items.description: (any bladed weapon) A boney blade with a spine and brain. Always: Bonus to attacks and damage: +1 (adventurer); +2 (champion); +3 (epic); and the weapon deals psychic damage. Chuulish recharge: Choose a nearby enemy. That enemy is now vulnerable to psychic damage until the end of the battle.
items.quirk: Large sphincters on arm where the ganglia-tentacles from the blade's hilt insert themselves.

items.name: Neural Whip
items.description: (light one-handed melee weapon) A tentacle snakes one end around your arm, inserting filaments beneath the skin. The whip stretches and flexes at your mental command, the tip studded with hardened pulsing nerves. Always: Bonus to attacks and damage: +1 (adventurer); +2 (champion); +3 (epic). 2/battle: You can use a reach trick with the whip (13th Age core book, page 44), and the attack deals psychic damage.
items.quirk: Grows eyes in unusual places.

items.name: Rachis Girdle
items.description: (belt) The pulsating band of chuul-flesh inside a bony cage sits on your lower back, exchanging blood and injecting substances into your organs. Always: Increase your maximum hp by +4 (champion: +10 hp; epic: +25 hp). Whenever you take ongoing damage, reduce that damage by your level.
items.quirk: Odd gait from reconfigured pelvis.

items.name: Rasping Greaves
items.description: (boots) A carapace covers each of your legs and has an unblinking armored eye on the knee. Unfolding blade-like appendages whip out at those engaged with you. Always: When you make an opportunity attack, the target takes +1d6 extra damage on a hit (champion: +2d8; epic: +4d10).
items.quirk: A billow-like lung inside each greave makes a breathing sound.

items.name: Strider Symbiote
items.description: (cloak/mantle - champion tier item) This living "backpack" clings to you with tentacles and inserts mouthparts into the top of your spine. The segmented limbs of the strider usually lie flat against your body but may be commanded to spring out and carry you like a long-legged spider. Always: +2 PD (champion); +3 PD (epic). Chuulish recharge: Until the end of the battle or for five minutes, you can move on walls or ceilings as easily as you do across the ground. (epic: chuulish recharge starts at 11+)
items.quirk: Twitching antenna.

items.name: Xenoteros
items.description: (cloak/mantle) Insectile wings hide in slits under the always itching skin of your back. Always: +1 PD (adventurer); +2 PD (champion); +3 PD (epic). Chuulish recharge: As a standard action, you can fly clumsily for one round (champion: 1d3 + 1 rounds; epic: 2d4 rounds).
items.quirk: Insectile mouthparts grow at the back of the throat and squiggle out when wearer talks excitedly.

items.name: Dancing Shoes
items.description: (boots) Shiny red shoes with golden wings. Always: The shoes force you to dance whenever you hear music (even off-key whistling will work). The shoes magically re-appear on your feet if taken off for more than 10 minutes. Recharge 6+: You gain a +3 bonus to disengage checks until the end of the battle (or five minutes).

items.name: Deck of Many Cards
items.description: (wondrous item) A divination deck. Always: The deck of cards continually grows, and you find your pockets and pouches filling with cards that spill out leaving a trail for anyone to follow. Occasionally, the cards spill out in a prophetic pattern that might have meaning to the owner or an ally.

items.name: Disappointment Hat
items.description: (hat) Green conical hat. Always: Each time you cast a spell outside of combat or a spell is cast near you, it has some side effect (GM's choice) that inconveniences you. Recharge 6+: As a move action you pull out an item from the hat. Roll a d6 to see what you get: 1-2: You get a useless or disgusting item. 3-6: You pull a useful non-magical item that grants a +d6 bonus to your next skill check until the end of your next turn.

items.name: Tome of Misfortune
items.description: (implement) Book with an embossed face inside its cover. 1/day: Regain one expended daily spell that you have cast. When you cast the recovered spell, roll a d6. 1-3: The book chooses the targets for the spell and can consider you and your allies as enemies, or your enemies as allies. 4-6: You choose targets normally.

items.name: Treasured Chest
items.description: (wondrous item) It follows you on little feet, obeys you, and is much larger on the inside (able to hold the same amount of stuff as a large closet). Always: You can't move faster than the chest, and the chest is slow. You travel at half speed everywhere and can't use actions to move twice during a turn in battle.

items.name: Acrobat's Stick
items.description: (staff) A glowing rod that expands into a longer pole. Always: Bonus to attacks and damage: +2 (adventurer). In addition, if you are a rogue with the swashbuckle ability, you gain an extra use of that ability, but whenever you roll a natural 1 or 2 with any d20 roll, the staff flings you into danger (you take 2d6 damage and possibly provoke opportunity attacks in battle).

items.name: Anger Armor
items.description: (heavy armor) Platemail or similar with leering faces on the pauldrons. Always: +2 AC (adventurer). In addition, when you miss with an attack and the escalation die is odd, roll a save; on a failure, you are enraged until the start of your next turn and take a -4 penalty to all defenses.

items.name: Backbiter Bow
items.description: (bow) Gold bow with no string. It creates a glowing string and "energy arrows." Always: Bonus to attacks and damage: +2 (adventurer). In addition, when you miss with an attack and the escalation die is odd, roll a save; on a failure, you instead hit yourself with the attack.

items.name: Blade of Unerring Panache
items.description: (+2 weapon) When you attack with this weapon and miss, you lose 4 hp (champion: 10 hp; epic: 25 hp).
items.quirk: Tells the same stories over and over.

items.name: Sword of Relentless Glory
items.description: (+2 weapon) If you don't make a melee attack with this weapon during your turn, it shuts down and its default bonus becomes +0 until the end of the battle.
items.quirk: Spouts furious curses in battle.

items.name: Wand of the Bloodless Mage
items.description: (+2 implement) When you attack using this wand, you lose 1 hp (champion: 3 hp; epic: 6 hp).
items.quirk: Laughs turn hollow or spectral.

items.name: Axe of Bloody Vengeance
items.description: (+3 weapon) You cannot rally during a battle.
items.quirk: Carves patterns into own skin with fingernails.

items.name: Bait Breastplate
items.description: (any armor) Thick metal plate cuirass that attracts ranged attacks and spells even as it deflects melee attacks. Always: +3 AC (champion) against melee attacks, but -1 AC against ranged attacks.

items.name: Brazen Armor
items.description: (+3 armor) When an attack against your AC crits you, the armor "goes quiet" and its default bonus becomes +0 until the end of the battle.
items.quirk: Becomes unreliable with forgettable tasks.

items.name: Cudgel of Heedlessness
items.description: (heavy two-handed melee weapon) A strangely glowing crude wooden club. Always: Bonus to attacks and damage: +3 (champion). In addition, when you roll a natural 1 with a melee attack using this weapon, you hit a random nearby ally with that attack and deal maximum damage. If you try to use a different weapon, the cudgel will teleport into your hand.

items.name: Ring of Delusion
items.description: (ring) Ring made out of complex interlocking wooden pieces. Always: Whenever there are two possible explanations and one is obviously ridiculous, that is what you believe provided there is no obvious and direct proof that contradicts your delusion. In addition, you gain +3 bonus to checks to find traps and see through illusions.

items.name: Chicken Shield
items.description: (shield) A fancy cavalier's shield. Always: +35 hp (epic). In addition, when you miss with an attack and the escalation die is odd, roll a save; on a failure, you run away from that enemy as far as you can go (no disengage check, take opportunity attacks).

items.name: Danger Bracers
items.description: (light armor) Chains welded into forearm armor. Always: +4 AC (epic). In addition, you can't disengage from enemies.

items.name: Procrastination Tome
items.description: (implement) This book contains instructions for being a better spellcaster. Always: Bonus to spell attacks and damage: +5 (epic). In addition, during the first round of each battle you must spend all your actions either moving or "limbering up." This means not using any abilities, you're just jogging and stretching.

items.name: Great Low Sickle
items.description: (+5 weapon) You deal +5 damage with missed attacks, but all of your defenses take a -3 penalty.

items.name: Staff of Dark Karma
items.description: (3/day) When you hit with a spell attack, deal extra damage to one target. If the spell targets one enemy, deal +4d10 damage. Otherwise, deal +2d10 damage. In addition, the first time you take damage each battle, you lose 20 hp.
